item_short_desc: Stay hands-free and organized with Rothco's Crossbody Fanny Pack. Crafted from durable Oxford polyester, this versatile pack offers 3 zippered compartments to securely store your essentials. The adjustable 53-inch quick-release strap allows you to wear it around your waist or across your body for added convenience and style. Ideal for outdoor adventures, travel, or daily errands, the lightweight design makes it an excellent companion wherever you go.
